# `grow-opentelemetry-collector` (crate `grow_opentelemetry_collector`) — agent quickstart (Rust)

Ships inside the crate (`~/.cargo/registry/src/*/grow-opentelemetry-collector-X.Y.Z/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/opentelemetry-collector/ · Service: OpenTelemetry Collector · Categories: logging,tracing.

```sh
cargo add grow-opentelemetry-collector && cargo add tokio --features macros,rt-multi-thread
```

## Client

```rust
let client = grow_opentelemetry_collector::OtelCollectorClient::new(grow_opentelemetry_collector::OtelCollectorConfig::from_env()?)?;
client.close().await;
```

Errors: `grow_opentelemetry_collector::Error` with `code()` (`ErrorCode::NotFound`, …). Credentials are `Secret`.

## Logging: one call

```rust
use grow_opentelemetry_collector::logging::{init_logging, InitOptions};
let log = init_logging(InitOptions { service: Some("orders".into()), ..Default::default() });
log.logger().log(grow_opentelemetry_collector::logging::Severity::Info, "started", Default::default());
// tracing: tracing_subscriber::registry().with(LogLayer::new(log.client())).init();
log.close().await?;
```

- JSON lines on stdout (`time`, `level`, `msg`, `service`, `environment`, `request_id`, `trace_id`, attributes,
  redacted); with `GROW_LOGGING_PROVIDER=opentelemetry-collector` also shipped (`log_shipped:"sdk"`, failed exports re-emitted
  with `"sdk_failed"`). Handle: `logger()`, `client()`, `shipped()`, `flush()`, `close()`, `canary(msg, attrs)`.
- `with_request_id(id, future)`, `current_request_id()`.
